title: The combination of CD138/MUM1 dual-staining and artificial intelligence for plasma cell counting in the diagnosis of chronic endometritis.
authors: Xiong, Zhongtang; Zhang, Wei; Liu, Shaoyan; Liu, Kai; Wang, Jin; Qin, Ping; Liu, Yuping; Jiang, Qingping
journal: American journal of reproductive immunology (New York, N.Y. : 1989)
one_liner_zh: 该文用CD138/MUM1双染和AI计数浆细胞诊断慢性子宫内膜炎，属临床病理诊断，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the utility of combination of CD138/MUM1 dual-staining (DS) and artificial intelligence (AI) for plasma cell (PC) counting in the diagnosis of chronic endometritis (CE). METHODS: Two hundred ninety-eight infertile women underwent endometrial biopsy were included. In 100 women, three successive sections were cut from each paraffin-embedded tissue block for CD138 immunohistochemical (IHC) single-staining (SS), MUM1 SS and CD138/MUM1 DS. The prevalence of CE and the sensitivity/specificity in the diagnosis of CE with different methods was studied. These sections diagnosed as CE with DS were collected to train artificial intelligence (AI) diagnostic system. In other 198 women, their tissue sections stained with CD138/MUM1 DS were used to test the AI system in the diagnosis of CE. RESULTS: CD138/MUM1 DS revealed that the cell membranes and nuclei of PCs were simultaneously labelled by CD138 and MUM1, respectively. The positive rate of ECs identified by CD138/MUM1 DS (38%, 38/100) was lower than CD138 SS (52%, 52/100) and MUM1 SS (62%, 62/100) (p < .05). The sensitivity, specificity and accuracy of CD138/MUM1 DS in the diagnosis of ECs reached 100%. The sensitivity, specificity and accuracy rates of AI diagnostic system of ECs were 100%, 83.3% and 91.4%, respectively. The 17 cases over-diagnosed as EC with the AI were corrected quickly by pathologists reviewing these false PC pictures listed by the AI. CONCLUSION: The combination of CD138/MUM1 DS and AI is a promising method to improve the accuracy and efficiency of CE diagnosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨CD138/MUM1双染（DS）与人工智能（AI）联合用于浆细胞（PC）计数在慢性子宫内膜炎（CE）诊断中的价值。方法：纳入298例接受子宫内膜活检的不孕女性。其中100例，从每块石蜡包埋组织中连续切取三张切片，分别进行CD138免疫组化（IHC）单染（SS）、MUM1单染（SS）和CD138/MUM1双染（DS）。研究了不同方法下CE的患病率及诊断CE的敏感性/特异性。将经DS诊断为CE的切片收集用于训练人工智能（AI）诊断系统。其余198例女性，其组织切片经CD138/MUM1 DS染色后，用于测试AI系统在CE诊断中的表现。结果：CD138/MUM1 DS显示，PC的细胞膜和细胞核分别被CD138和MUM1同时标记。CD138/MUM1 DS识别的ECs阳性率（38%，38/100）低于CD138 SS（52%，52/100）和MUM1 SS（62%，62/100）（p < .05）。CD138/MUM1 DS在ECs诊断中的敏感性、特异性和准确性均达到100%。AI诊断系统对ECs的敏感性、特异性和准确性分别为100%、83.3%和91.4%。AI过度诊断为ECs的17例病例，由病理学家快速审查AI列出的这些假PC图像后予以纠正。结论：CD138/MUM1 DS与AI联合是提高CE诊断准确性和效率的一种有前景的方法。
